Name: Busy Bar Sign
Author: Ian Woodall
Description: Shows what Busy Bar Sign says on a key, and starts or ends Do Not Disturb when you press it. Mute and Leave keys for your Teams or Zoom meeting. Wandering, Lunch and Back In keys for when you leave your desk.

Actions.Name: Status
Actions.Tooltip: What the sign says, live. Press to start or end Do Not Disturb.

Actions.Name: Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Mutes or unmutes your Teams or Zoom meeting. Green LIVE, red MUTED.

Actions.Name: Leave
Actions.Tooltip: Leaves your Teams or Zoom meeting. Hold for a second to end a Zoom meeting you host for everyone.

Actions.Name: Wandering
Actions.Tooltip: In the building, not at your desk: the sign says WANDERING, and the screen saver locks the Mac. Press again to end it.

Actions.Name: Lunch
Actions.Tooltip: Out for lunch: the sign says LUNCH, and the screen saver locks the Mac. Press again to end it.

Actions.Name: Back In
Actions.Tooltip: BACK IN with a countdown: ten minutes a press, three presses for half an hour. Hold for a second when you're back.
